description: Read the bounded, cursor-paginated feed of currently active eligibility publication replacements since an ISO timestamp. Use it to invalidate caches keyed by credit_union_id or publication identity. It exposes aggregate publication metadata only: no personal facts, no historical verdict, and no claim that a person is eligible or ineligible.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the prior page; do not construct or modify it.

since.description: Exclusive ISO 8601 activation boundary with an offset.

name: get_eligibility_changes

outputSchema.description: Cursor-paginated active-publication replacement feed for cache invalidation.

changes.description: Active publication replacements in stable ascending order.

change.description: Prior publication id when present and aggregate current membership-kind counts.

credit_union_id.description: Stable credit-union id whose active publication changed.

disclosure.description: Required warning that this is not a personal eligibility verdict or full history.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null.

returned.description: Number of changes in this page.
